description: DeFi TVL: Current total value locked for a DeFi protocol (by DefiLlama slug) or a chain (by name, with its rank among all tracked chains). Source: DefiLlama. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: kind, tvl_usd, and for chains rank, of_chains.

chain.description: chain name such as Base, Ethereum, Solana (optional; one of protocol or chain is required)

protocol.description: DefiLlama protocol slug such as aave, uniswap, aerodrome (optional)

name: x420_defi_tvl
